components.note: CNN 恐懼與貪婪指數由 7 個因子等權組成：市場動能（S&P 500 相對 125 日均線）、股價強度（創 52 週新高與新低的家數）、股價廣度（上漲股與下跌股的成交量）、選擇權賣權／買權比、市場波動（VIX 相對 50 日均線）、避險需求（股票與債券 20 日報酬差），以及垃圾債需求（垃圾債與投資級債的利差）。台灣的恐懼與貪婪指數依此架構略做調整：部分因子在台灣無法找到直接對應的資料，因此改以相近的台灣市場資料替代，例如以台灣與美國公債殖利率利差取代垃圾債需求，共 8 個面向。各面向的數值為其在歷史區間中的相對位置（0–1）。

narrative.title: 窄幅強勢
paragraphs: 表面上動能偏多、波動低、資金偏風險資產，屬於 Risk-On 環境；
但市場廣度極低、公債殖利率差偏平，代表指數雖強，上漲的基礎並不寬廣。
少數權值股推升指數，但多數個股參與不足；
公債殖利率曲線偏平，總經面的疑慮尚未解除。

strategy.note: 本站擇時策略以 TWGFI 等指標在 0050、正二與現金之間切換。曲線為回測淨值（起點＝100），以隔日開盤價成交、已扣手續費與證交稅；非實際帳戶績效，過去表現不代表未來。共識版為研究中的候選規則：恐懼判斷改由多種指標同時確認；尚未用於本站策略，僅供比較。

table.note: 定期定額：每月第一個交易日投入 1 萬元（已扣手續費）；兩個擇時策略另於市場下跌達一定幅度時額外投入，故累積投入較多，期末市值不宜直接相比。策略績效（時間加權）：不受投入金額與時點影響的淨值表現，用來比較策略本身。年化 TWR（時間加權報酬）＝（∏（1＋rₜ））^（365.25÷期間日曆天數）－1，rₜ 為每日報酬（隔日開盤價成交、已扣手續費與證交稅）；期間內無資金進出，故與淨值的年複合成長率相同。

en.CNN 恐懼與貪婪指數由 7 個因子等權組成：市場動能（S&P 500 相對 1: The CNN Fear & Greed Index combines 7 equally weighted factors: market momentum (the S&P 500 versus its 125-day moving average), stock price strength (stocks at 52-week highs versus lows), stock price breadth (volume in advancing versus declining stocks), the put/call options ratio, market volatility (the VIX versus its 50-day moving average), safe-haven demand (20-day stock versus bond returns), and junk bond demand (the spread between junk and investment-grade bonds). The Taiwan Fear & Greed Index follows this framework with slight adjustments: some factors have no direct counterpart in Taiwan, so similar Taiwan market data are used instead — for example, Taiwan and US government bond yield spreads replace junk bond demand — for a total of 8 components. Each component's value is its relative position within its historical range (0–1).

en.定期定額：每月第一個交易日投入 1 萬元（已扣手續費）；兩個擇時策略另於市場下跌: Monthly investing: NT$10,000 on the first trading day of each month (net of fees); the two timing strategies also invest extra when the market falls by a set amount, so they invest more in total and their ending values should not be compared directly. Strategy performance (time-weighted): NAV performance unaffected by the amount and timing of contributions, used to compare the strategies themselves. Annualized TWR (time-weighted return) = (∏(1 + rₜ))^(365.25 ÷ calendar days in the period) − 1, where rₜ is the daily return (filled at the next day's open, net of fees and transaction tax). With no cash flows during the period, it equals the compound annual growth rate of the NAV.

en.數值為 v3 分數在自身過去三年（約 756 個交易日）中的百分位，取 5 日平: The value is the percentile of the v3 score within its own past three years (about 756 trading days), averaged over 5 days. v3 follows the CNN convention (low volatility is read as the absence of panic), so its raw score runs persistently high and is shown as a percentile instead.

This is not actual account performance; past performance does not guarantee future results. The consensus variant is a research candidate: its fear signal requires confirmation from multiple indicators. It is not used by our strategy and is shown for comparison only.
